planning_notes: The request for 5 targets is fulfilled by selecting 5 distinct core concepts from the available pool of 9. This ensures that while the concepts are related (all part of building a neural network), the assessment angles (mechanism, rationale, code, prediction, and error diagnosis) are distinct, covering a broad range of cognitive skills from understanding to analysis.
